implementation: Optional visual-only suspension in the existing presentation component/config/frame/AnimInstance; default disabled, no new Tick or module/plugin.
Caches spin centers and suspension reference transforms by wheel identity; no animated-pose feedback.
Up to four simple WorldStatic object traces per active vehicle update, including Movable floors; self and held ball ignored, simulated/Pawn/ball hits rejected.
Vehicle-down probes; world-up and vehicle-up normal filtering; radius/plane tangent correction; bounded per-wheel world-cm travel and exponential smoothing.
No hit droops; excessive tilt or active self-righting fades neutral and skips queries; existing lifecycle resets apply.
Converts vehicle-up world displacement through mesh and reference bone transforms to additive Bone Space translation.
Same local source/calculation on host, owner and observer; no per-wheel replication, physics history changes, force, root/ball/HP/GAS rule mutation.
Future physical wheel observations replace the target source; no extra physical suspension framework implemented.
hal.VehicleSuspensionDebug defaults off; trace counts, per-query timing and a cycle stat expose costs.
